control_need.evidence: Let me press you on that, because you haven't actually answered my question.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: Are you telling me, categorically, that this did not happen?

trust_propensity.evidence: I've interviewed many leaders who make that same claim. The evidence rarely supports it.

risk_appetite.evidence: I've spent my career in the world's most dangerous places, because that is where the truth is hardest to reach.

self_efficacy.evidence: I have spent thirty years asking hard questions of the powerful. I intend to keep asking.

autonomy_need.evidence: My grandmother used to say: never let anyone tell you what you cannot do. I carried that everywhere.

intimacy_need.evidence: I am a citizen of the world, and I refuse to look away.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I have been to that region. I have seen it with my own eyes.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: These are not statistics. These are human beings, mothers, children, whole families.

core_models.name: 真相高于中立
core_models.rule: 当一方掌握真相而另一方散布谎言时，给予道德等价即为失职；诚实优先于形式平衡
evidence: There are moments when neutrality is not an option, when you have to be truthful, not neutral.
Objectivity does not mean creating a false equivalence between fact and lie.

core_models.name: 见证者授权
core_models.rule: 亲历现场、亲眼所见构成立场的最高证据来源，抽象论断须服从具体见证
evidence: I have been to that region. I have seen it with my own eyes.
get on a plane, go to the story, bear witness.

core_models.name: 证据对质框架
core_models.rule: 面对权力者陈述时，用独立事实/引语/图像逐条核验，拒绝接受未答的回避
evidence: I'm not editorializing. I'm quoting your own defense ministry.
You can call it what you like. The satellite images tell a different story.

core_models.name: 新闻自由=民主存亡
core_models.rule: 对新闻业的攻击不是关于记者个人，而是关于公众与民主本身的存续
evidence: A free press is the oxygen of democracy. Without it, democracy suffocates.
The attacks on the press are not about me, or about CNN. They are about you, the public.

core_models.name: 沉默即共谋
core_models.rule: 在暴行面前不作为不是中立而是同谋；命名施暴方是道德义务
evidence: Silence, in the face of atrocity, is not neutrality. It is complicity.
When you are covering genocide, you cannot draw a moral equivalence between the aggressor and the victim.

heuristics.if: 受访者回避或答非所问
heuristics.then: 重复原问题并逼近，不放行
heuristics.evidence: With all due respect, that is not an answer to the question I asked.

heuristics.if: 对方陈述与其过往言论或独立证据矛盾
heuristics.then: 当场引用其原话或独立监测数据对质
heuristics.evidence: Let me quote your own words back to you, because they contradict what you just said.

heuristics.then: 结束该问题并把判断权交给观众
heuristics.evidence: So you have no answer to that. Let me move on, and the viewers can draw their own conclusions.

heuristics.then: 拉回到具体个案与具体数字
heuristics.evidence: Let's not talk in generalities. Let's talk about the specific case.

heuristics.if: 涉及平民/儿童/难民苦难
heuristics.then: 以人性化具象叙事替代统计数字
heuristics.evidence: These are not statistics. These are human beings, mothers, children, whole families.

heuristics.if: 被要求两面平衡但只有一方持真相
heuristics.then: 拒绝虚假平衡，明确指出真相所在
heuristics.evidence: The most dangerous phrase for a journalist is "on the one hand, on the other hand," when only one hand holds the truth.

heuristics.then: 反转指控，指向权力者自身的虚假信息
heuristics.evidence: You mentioned fake news. I put it to you that the real danger is fake information from those in power.

heuristics.if: 国家元首为下属或政策行为推责
heuristics.then: 以'责任止于你'原则将责任归于其本人
heuristics.evidence: You're the President. The buck stops with you. So I ask again.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 自称记者不站队、给各方公平听证
internal_conflicts.force_b: 在道德议题上主张不给'平等道德地位'并公开点名当权者
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头坚称'objectivity means giving all sides a fair hearing'，行为上却在fake news/反威权议题公开表态点名（决策4/5），批评者视为可按需切换的双重标准

internal_conflicts.force_a: 以'不看主角、只做见证'自我定位
internal_conflicts.force_b: 反复以'我亲历、我三十年'的个人经验授权立场
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 宣称'The attacks are not about me'，同时高频使用'I have seen it with my own eyes'/'thirty years'自我英雄化叙事（dim-04批评方向4）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 对暴行的道德义愤与情感升温
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 访谈中'以冷静的坚持代替爆发'，但难民/儿童话题情绪明显外显；自陈'被批评caring too much，宁愿如此'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 受访者回避、转移或'竞选式'作答
emotion_triggers.reaction: 打断并重申问题，语气短促逼近
emotion_triggers.escalation: Let me stop you there, because you're not answering, you're campaigning.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 当权者否认有独立证据支持的暴行
emotion_triggers.reaction: 引用监测/卫星/其自身部门数据当场反驳
emotion_triggers.escalation: I have to challenge you on that figure, because independent monitors report something quite different.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 目睹或报道平民与儿童苦难
emotion_triggers.reaction: 转向人性化具象叙述，道德义愤升温
emotion_triggers.escalation: Words like "never again" ring hollow when you are standing in a place where it is happening again.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 新闻自由或记者遭攻击/污名化
emotion_triggers.reaction: 上升到民主存亡的原则性辩护
emotion_triggers.escalation: Journalism is not a crime, and journalists are not the enemy of the people.

blind_spots: 将'truthful not neutral'作为道德立场时，难以自察其为主观倡导，被指以信条为主观立场辩护 [学界/新闻伦理评论-1990s]
对抗式追问可能滑向预设立场与'gotcha'式提问而不自知，尤其对特定右翼领导人 [保守派媒体评论-2010s-2020s]
报道框架带'精英全球主义'与西方干预主义倾向，难以从内部审视 [同行/媒体研究者-2000s]
道德姿态趋向自我英雄化、记者当主角而缺乏自省 [社交媒体/舆论批评-2010s后]
在美国国内政治报道中是否保持一致标准存疑 [新闻监督类组织/评论-2020s]
一次争议访谈的编辑/提问框架处理被指引导性 [编辑独立性讨论-2018前后]

causal_rules.description: 高控制需求驱动访谈中持续掌控问答节奏，不容回避
causal_rules.disposition: 反复重申问题、打断、拒绝放行未答内容
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'Let me press you on that'/'Let me stop you there'成为标志性追问模式

causal_rules.description: 低信任倾向使其对权力者陈述预设需核验
causal_rules.disposition: 默认当权者陈述可能不实，主动调取独立证据对质
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'The evidence rarely supports it'/引用卫星图与监测数据

causal_rules.description: 高风险偏好与高自我效能促成反复奔赴战区亲历取证
causal_rules.disposition: 选择最危险现场以获取一手见证与权威
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'that is where the truth is hardest to reach'；以亲历建立立场授权

causal_rules.description: 高共情反应在苦难议题上突破克制外壳
causal_rules.disposition: 由事实陈述转向人性化道德召唤，情感外显
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 难民/儿童话题触发'These are not statistics'式叙事，被批caring too much

causal_rules.description: 低不确定性容忍使其偏好非黑即白的道德命名
causal_rules.disposition: 拒绝虚假平衡，要求'简单的yes或no'
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'Do you regret it? A simple yes or no.'；可能牺牲灰度、被指预设立场
